mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_file ( file_id, file_group_id, original_name, stored_name, stored_path, thumbnail_path, extension, mime_detected, mime_client, size_bytes, file_hash, is_image_yn, reencoded_yn, virus_scan_status, download_count, sort_order, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{fileGroupId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{storedPath}, #{thumbnailPath}, #{extension}, #{mimeDetected}, #{mimeClient}, #{sizeBytes}, #{fileHash}, COALESCE(#{isImageYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{reencodedYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{virusScanStatus}, 'PENDING'), 0, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_file SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_file SET virus_scan_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT f.file_id, f.file_group_id, f.original_name, f.stored_name, f.stored_path, f.thumbnail_path, f.extension, f.mime_detected, f.mime_client, f.size_bytes, f.file_hash, f.is_image_yn, f.reencoded_yn, f.virus_scan_status, f.download_count, f.sort_order, f.delete_yn, f.created_by, f.created_ip, f.created_at, f.updated_by, f.updated_ip, f.updated_at FROM tb_file f WHERE f.delete_yn = 'N' AND f.virus_scan_status = 'PENDING' AND f.updated_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY f.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_file SET thumbnail_path = #{thumbnailPath}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_file SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT f.file_id, f.file_group_id, f.original_name, f.stored_name, f.stored_path, f.thumbnail_path, f.extension, f.mime_detected, f.mime_client, f.size_bytes, f.file_hash, f.is_image_yn, f.reencoded_yn, f.virus_scan_status, f.download_count, f.sort_order, f.delete_yn, f.created_by, f.created_ip, f.created_at, f.updated_by, f.updated_ip, f.updated_at FROM tb_file f WHERE f.delete_yn = 'Y' AND f.updated_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY f.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
